big_case.notes: Solicitor General petition asking whether the First Amendment bars viewpoint-based award or termination of competitive federal research grants (NSF/NEH), arising from a classwide preliminary injunction and tied to a wave of grant-termination suits. A merits ruling would have been nationally significant; the plain denial with no noted dissent leaves the Ninth Circuit ruling in place at an interlocutory stage and lowers the realized significance of this docket.
